exposure: sex and weight of the baby
cohort: Women who had stillbirths at seven Health facilities in the Asante-Akim South district of Ghana between January 1, 2010, and December 31, 2012.
finding: The stillbirth rate was 22.2 per 1000 births, with the leading causes being unexplained intrauterine foetal death (18.4%), prolonged/obstructed labour (14.9%), hypertensive disease (9.9%), and malaria in pregnancy (8.5%).
gest_age: 60.0% of the stillbirths occurred within 36-41 weeks of gestation.
birth_weight: Not specified, but low birth weight is mentioned as a contributing factor to stillbirth.
